objectsSameEngine: Views and procedures can only be carried between databases of the same engine

table.copyLeft: Copy the table to the left
table.copyRight: Copy the table to the right
table.createLeft: Create the table on the left
table.createRight: Create the table on the right
table.deleteLeft: Delete the table on the left
table.deleteRight: Delete the table on the right

object.copyLeft: Copy the object to the left
object.copyRight: Copy the object to the right
object.createLeft: Create the object on the left
object.createRight: Create the object on the right
object.deleteLeft: Delete the object on the left
object.deleteRight: Delete the object on the right

pk.copyLeft: Copy the primary key to the left
pk.copyRight: Copy the primary key to the right

props.copyLeft: Copy the comment and options to the left
props.copyRight: Copy the comment and options to the right

sync.unsupported: {{engine}} doesn't apply schema changes from DBine
sync.confirmWarnings: Check the warnings before going on.
sync.noChanges: Nothing to sync: carry changes with the → / ← arrows
sync.changes_one: {{count}} change (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.changes_many: {{count}} changes (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.changes_other: {{count}} changes (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.confirmOrder: Left first, then right; if anything fails, it stops there.
sync.emptyScript: This side has pending changes, but the script is empty: there is no statement to apply them. Nothing will run here. Review the changes or discard them.
sync.destructiveTables_one: {{count}} table is deleted with all its data: {{names}}
sync.destructiveTables_many: {{count}} tables are deleted with all their data: {{names}}
sync.destructiveTables_other: {{count}} tables are deleted with all their data: {{names}}
sync.destructiveColumns_one: {{count}} column is deleted with its data: {{names}}
sync.destructiveColumns_many: {{count}} columns are deleted with their data: {{names}}
sync.destructiveColumns_other: {{count}} columns are deleted with their data: {{names}}
sync.confirmDestructive: Some tables, columns or objects will be deleted and can't be recovered.
sync.confirmDependents_one: {{count}} object that depends on what is deleted may stop working.
sync.confirmDependents_many: {{count}} objects that depend on what is deleted may stop working.
sync.confirmDependents_other: {{count}} objects that depend on what is deleted may stop working.
sync.confirmDepsFailed_one: Couldn't check the dependencies of {{count}} item being deleted.
sync.confirmDepsFailed_many: Couldn't check the dependencies of {{count}} items being deleted.
sync.confirmDepsFailed_other: Couldn't check the dependencies of {{count}} items being deleted.
sync.confirmDepsIncomplete_one: The dependency check for {{count}} item is incomplete.
sync.confirmDepsIncomplete_many: The dependency check for {{count}} items is incomplete.
sync.confirmDepsIncomplete_other: The dependency check for {{count}} items is incomplete.

empty.pick: Choose the two databases (or two schemas) and click {compare}.
empty.help: Differences are carried from one side to the other with the arrows and applied with {sync}, which shows the script before running it.

pickItem: Choose a table or object from the list.

indexUsage.share: {{pct}} of the table's reads in this database ({{reads}} reads)
indexUsage.unused: No reads in this database and {{updates}} writes since statistics began

drop.title: Delete…
drop.lastColumn: A table needs at least one column
drop.cascade_one: {{side}}: {{count}} foreign key that references it is also removed ({{tables}})
drop.cascade_many: {{side}}: {{count}} foreign keys that reference it are also removed ({{tables}})
drop.cascade_other: {{side}}: {{count}} foreign keys that reference it are also removed ({{tables}})
drop.referenced: {{side}}: foreign key {{fk}} of {{table}} points to this key; the engine may reject the deletion
drop.referencedColumn: {{side}}: foreign key {{fk}} of {{table}} points to this column; the engine may reject the deletion
drop.withColumn_one: {{side}}: what uses it is also removed: {{items}}
drop.withColumn_many: {{side}}: {{count}} items that use it are also removed: {{items}}
drop.withColumn_other: {{side}}: {{count}} items that use it are also removed: {{items}}
drop.computed: {{side}}: computed column {{column}} uses it; the engine may reject the deletion
drop.pkRequired: {{engine}} doesn't allow a table without a primary key
drop.backsFk: {{side}}: MySQL uses this index for foreign key {{fk}}; the deletion may fail
drop.hiddenEqualTip: Uncheck “Differences only” to see them and be able to delete them

pending.left: It will be deleted on the left when syncing
pending.right: It will be deleted on the right when syncing
pending.both: It will be deleted on both sides when syncing

dropComment.left: Remove the comment on the left
dropComment.right: Remove the comment on the right
dropComment.both: Remove the comment on both sides

deps.title: What depends on what is deleted
deps.tooMany: Not checked: the first {{limit}} items on each side are checked
deps.stopped: Not checked: the dialog was closed first
deps.incomplete_one: incomplete list: {{count}} object couldn't be read
deps.incomplete_many: incomplete list: {{count}} objects couldn't be read
deps.incomplete_other: incomplete list: {{count}} objects couldn't be read
deps.noneFound: Nothing found in what could be read
